note: Ozaukee County's only camping park, on the east bank of the Milwaukee River in Fredonia (W1155 Fredonia Ave). RVs may use the six water and electric sites and basic site 14; sites 6-9 and 14 take long rigs, while 10 and 15 are harder backing for 25 ft at most. The other basic sites are tent only, and 16-17 are walk-in. Sites 1-9 sit in a row above the river, across the park road and a mowed bank. Free boat and canoe launch. --Claude
